description.value: The Buvette is a cozy lunch spot in Squamish serving gourmet homemade sandwiches alongside coffee, natural wine, and beer. It sits with a view of the Stawamus Chief and doubles as a natural pit stop for cyclists travelling the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Squamish and Whistler. Outdoor seating and a take-away option make it easy for cyclists to refuel without lingering.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 16m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Buvette is an active sandwich-and-wine lunch spot at 1323 Vancouver St, Squamish, matching the OSM address exactly. The phrase 'grab your food to go' confirms takeout; the site also explicitly markets the business as a pit stop for Sea-to-Sky travelers. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
